management_steps.details: Titrate oxygen carefully to target Sats 88-92% (prevent hypercapnic respiratory drive failure). Deliver Salbutamol + Ipratropium Bromide nebs.
Give Hydrocortisone 200mg IV stat (or Prednisone 0.5mg/kg PO). If infection is suspected (increased sputum volume/purulence/fever): Augmentin 1g BD PO (or 1.2g IV) + Azithromycin 500mg PO daily.
NIV (BiPAP) is highly effective for COPD respiratory acidosis (pH < 7.35, PaCO2 > 45mmHg). Reduces intubation rates dramatically.
